description: Flame Frontier is an evidence dashboard for NASA’s microgravity combustion data. It maps every space fire test we could trace, from the PSI database and NASA papers, against the air future Moon-base crews will breathe, and shows where the evidence runs out: only 2 solid-material burns in Moon-base air, none in partial gravity. Every number links to its source. Built in Python and JavaScript, with a cited AI Q&A.
